visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an indoor bathroom where a young boy is sitting in a white bathtub filled with water. A woman with dark hair, seen from behind, is kneeling next to the tub, facing the child. The lighting is warm and domestic. (2) The woman reaches her hands towards the child to offer a hug, but the boy firmly pushes her hands away and turns his head. (3) The boy picks up a small, clear plastic cup and looks at the mother with a defiant expression before looking back down at the water. (4) The mother changes her posture, bringing her hands to her face to frame her cheeks in a 'cute' pose. The boy watches her intently. (5) The boy's expression softens; he breaks into a wide smile and mimics the mother's 'cute' gesture with his own hands while holding the cup. (6) The woman successfully scoops the child up in her arms, lifting him out of the bathtub. The frame concludes with a circular mask focusing on the boy's smiling face.
